**Seven people, including [[Stock car racing|stock car racer]] [[Greg Biffle]] and his family, are killed after Biffle's [[Cessna Citation II]] jet crashes while landing at [[Statesville Regional Airport]] in [[Statesville, North Carolina|Statesville]], [[North Carolina]], United States. '''International relations'''
*[[Taiwan–United States relations]]
**The United States approves a $11.1 billion arms sale to [[Taiwan]], including [[medium-range ballistic missile]]s, [[drone warfare|drones]], and [[howitzer]]s, as the largest arms deal in the history of bilateral relations between the two countries. [https://www.dw.com/en/us-approves-largest-arms-sale-to-taiwan/a-75211140 (DW)]
*The [[United Nations]] [[United Nations General Assembly|General Assembly]] elects former [[Iraq]]i [[President of Iraq|president]] [[Barham Salih]] as the next [[United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees|High Commissioner for Refugees]], succeeding [[Filippo Grandi]], whose term ends December 31. [https://www.reuters.com/world/un-elects-former-iraqi-president-lead-un-refugee-agency-2025-12-18/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mass shootings in the United States]]
**[[2025 Brown University shooting]]
***A 48-year-old suspect of the [[mass shooting]] at [[Brown University]] in [[Providence, Rhode Island|Providence]], [[Rhode Island]], United States, is found dead from a [[suicide by gunshot|self-inflicted gunshot wound]] inside of a storage unit in [[Salem, New Hampshire|Salem]], [[New Hampshire]]. Authorities are investigating whether the murder of [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] professor [[Nuno Loureiro]] is connected. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/live-blog/brown-university-suspect-shooting-death-mit-professor-live-updates-rcna249937#rcrd94751 (NBC News)]
*[[Besançon poisonings]]
**Frédéric Péchier, an [[anesthesiologist]] who was found guilty of poisoning 30 patients and killing twelve with [[Total intravenous anaesthesia|anesthetic infusion]] bags in [[Besançon]], [[Doubs]], [[France]], is sentenced to [[Life imprisonment in France|life in prison]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c2epv08xwz7o (BBC News)]
*[[Crime in Peru]]
**Councilwoman Elena Rojas is [[Assassination|assassinated]] and several others are injured, including at least four children, in a targeted mass shooting at a [[Christmas]] event in [[Chicama]], [[Department of La Libertad]], [[Peru]]. [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/12/councilwoman-killed-children-injured-in-shooting-at-christmas-event-in-peru/ (BNO News)]
*[[2025 Mannheim car attack]]
**The Mannheim Regional Court convicts Alexander Scheuermann, the perpetrator of a car attack in [[Mannheim]], [[Baden-Württemberg]], [[Germany]] on March 3, of two counts of murder and six counts of attempted murder, and sentences him to life imprisonment at a psychiatric facility. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/german-man-jailed-for-life-over-deadly-carnival-car-ramming (The Straits Times)]
*[[Terrorism in Russia]]
**A [[Russia]]n [[Military Courts (Russia)|military court]] sentences a [[Belarus]]ian national to 22 years in [[Prisons in Russia|prison]] for terrorism after convicting him of planting explosives on two [[Trans-Siberian Railway|freight trains]] in [[Buryatia]] in 2023, causing major damage and rail disruptions. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-jails-man-22-years-blowing-up-trains-siberia-ukraines-behest-2025-12-18/ (Reuters)]
